## Meso 0.2.2 Beta
This is a beta: new features arrive here first, before they've had as much testing. To go back, pick Stable in Settings › Updates › Update channel, and Meso moves over with the next stable version.
**New** - Time: Meso can keep track of what you work on, if you turn it on. See your day on a timeline, sort time into projects, search everything, add entries or run a timer, and export to CSV, JSON, Excel or PDF. It can also show your calendars and Reminders, and summarise your day with AI. - Keyboards: hold any key as a modifier, press two keys together as a chord, give a key a double tap, use sticky modifiers or hold a key to switch to a layer of your own. Hold and tap timing can be set per keyboard, and a key inspector shows what each press sends. - Profiles by input source: keys can do something different for each input source. - Displays: a new display page with brightness and colour, picture, input switching and modes. - Remotes: any Android TV voice remote and the Chromecast Voice Remote work for voice input with one press. A Xiaomi remote's power key can be mapped. - Siri Remote (third generation): its microphone can be used for voice input while the Siri button is held. Turning it on asks for administrator approval once. - Voice input: Meso switches to the voice app's input source while it listens and presses its key the way that app expects. Recipes now cover Doubao and Typeless. - Your data: Settings › Data shows what Meso keeps on this Mac and lets you delete each kind. Export everything to one file, optionally protected with a passphrase, and import it on another Mac. - Usage receipts print your name, your day count and streak with Meso, and your longest stretch of the day.
**Improved** - Meso uses far less memory: pages that briefly used about 300 MB while drawing now stay around 50–90 MB. - Settings opens faster in German, Japanese, Korean and Chinese. - Meso's files are kept in one tidy folder. They move there automatically the first time this version starts. - Recipes: the recipe panel floats over the recipes instead of squeezing them.
Requires macOS 14 or later. Ports, cables and displays need a Mac with Apple silicon.

## Meso 0.2.1
**Improved** - Open app actions switch back: when the app is already in front, the same gesture, button or recipe hides it and returns to the app you were using.
Requires macOS 14 or later. Ports, cables and displays need a Mac with Apple silicon.

## Meso 0.2.0
Mose is now **Meso**. This version can't update itself from Mose: download Meso once from [meso.ac](https://meso.ac) and open it. Your settings, recipes, paired computers and AI keys move over on their own. You can then delete Mose.
**New** - Welcome tour: try a few scene recipes as you set up, turn on the ones you like, and choose to open Meso at login.
**Improved** - Trackpad place gestures: the title bar, Dock and menu bar are drawn on your own desktop picture with the apps from your own Dock, and each gesture plays where it happens. - Scene Recipes: trackpad and keyboard recipes come first, the device tabs stay at the top while you scroll, the page responds faster, and each picture presses its control in time with the effect. - The sidebar keeps Cables folded, with a count, and shows a reader's picture and a laptop badge on built-in devices. - Sending a folder of thousands of files starts sooner, and memory is given back after large transfers.
**Fixed** - Left half and right half didn't move the window.
Requires macOS 14 or later. Ports, cables and displays need a Mac with Apple silicon.
